## Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Deferred Review Nitpick (minor, contained)

### Expected Behavior
The test-hardening commit (PR #573, 6734986bd9) added `trap '_restore_real_classifier' EXIT ERR INT TERM` in _install_stub_classifier to guarantee the stub classifier is restored. It must not disturb other EXIT traps.

### Actual Behavior
_install_stub_classifier (~line 989 of tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh) unconditionally registers its trap, OVERWRITING the `trap _cleanup EXIT` that git-fixtures.sh registers (~line 50, sourced at ~line 29). _restore_real_classifier (~line 1001) then runs `trap - EXIT ERR INT TERM`, clearing ALL EXIT traps including the original _cleanup, so _CLEANUP_DIRS fixture temp-dirs no longer fire on EXIT and leak. Confirmed by manual dso:code-reviewer-standard@opus during FP-recovery of PR #573 (reviewer hash d79d3f1b). Blast radius contained: under the suite runner each test runs in its own subprocess.

### Fix direction
Save the prior trap and chain/restore it (e.g., capture `trap -p EXIT` before overriding; in _restore_real_classifier re-install the saved trap rather than `trap - EXIT`). Fold into chunk 3 or a small cleanup PR.

### Logs/Evidence
PR #573; manual reviewer hash d79d3f1b5dc3cf6c8840c7d31de6c81ab5793a8ddc891e2b28623e6990882348
